scope: Audited remote CF alias sees seed and full bytes during parent held write-lock interval; remote read-only lock may succeed or block
alternatives: Remote seed visible by parent write-lock return while bytes still old; read-only lock returns before parent unlock.
Remote seed/bytes visibility requires parent unlock.
Read-only lock blocks until write unlock; bounded parent wait fails and cleanup retains failure.
ordering: Parent pauses at audited Mach acknowledgements before edits/after edits before unlock; receiver copies only while parent awaits its acknowledgement. No simultaneous writes.
